plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.taglineHtml: Eval-driven improvement, plus the harness to drive it
plugins.summaryHtml: Two parts form one loop. An edit → eval → keep/discard engine improves code, prompts, or docs. It scores each change with a shell command, an LLM judge, or both. It shows progress in a live Artifact dashboard. A harness builder measures project health in six categories. It creates feedback loops, evals, sensors, and context management advisories. It then fixes the top-ranked issue through the same loop.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 以評測驅動改進，並提供驅動它的 harness
zhTW.summaryHtml: 外掛由兩個部分組成一個循環。核心是「編輯 → 評測 → 保留或捨棄」引擎。引擎可以改進程式碼、提示詞或文件。引擎用 shell 指令、LLM 評審或兩者，為每次修改評分。進度顯示在即時的 Artifact 儀表板上。Harness 建構器從六個類別衡量專案健康度。建構器會建立回饋循環、評測、感測器，以及管理脈絡的建議。然後，建構器用同一個循環修正排名最高的問題。

plugins.oneLiner: Eval-driven improvement loop (keep/discard with a live Artifact dashboard) plus a dev-lifecycle harness builder that measures project health and creates feedback loops, evals, and sensors. Inspired by karpathy/autoresearch.

commands.name: /autoresearch:harness-build
commands.descriptionHtml: Menu-driven scaffolder for harness components: feedback loop, eval loop, sensor, or context-mgmt advisory. Writes Tier-1 artifacts into your project's .claude/.

commands.name: /autoresearch:harness-check
commands.descriptionHtml: Scan project health across code quality, tests, runtime, architecture, scriptability, and harness completeness. Produces a scored harness report with impact-ranked improvements

commands.name: /autoresearch:harness-improvement
commands.descriptionHtml: Execute improvement loop on the top-ranked harness issue: auto-generates eval from probes and spawns the autoresearch:experimenter agent

commands.name: /autoresearch:improve
commands.descriptionHtml: Iteratively improve any artifact using an edit-eval-keep/discard loop with live dashboard

skills.name: experiment-loop
skills.descriptionHtml: Core iteration logic for autoresearch: edit target, run eval, keep or discard, update dashboard, repeat.

skills.name: harness-probes
skills.descriptionHtml: Guide for adding custom probes to the harness check system.

changes.html: libs now load when a command or skill sources them from zsh. They fall back to $0 when BASH_SOURCE is unset, and functions use AR_PLUGIN_DIR and AR_TEMPLATES_DIR instead. Before this fix, sourcing from zsh outside the plugin failed with BASH_SOURCE[0]: parameter not set.

LLM-judge evals use three blind autoresearch:judge agents. Each judge compares the last kept version with the edit, and a strict majority must prefer the edit to keep it. The experimenter no longer scores its own edit.
add min_delta to the experiment configuration. A shell-metric gain at or below it is discarded and counts toward the stopping limit. The default 0 keeps the old behavior.
/autoresearch:improve adds a default size cap of 150% of baseline for text targets. An edit over the cap is discarded without eval.
/autoresearch:improve offers claude plugin eval as the shell eval for skill and plugin targets.
state the eval-metrics guard in /autoresearch:improve once, with its reason, instead of five times with rising emphasis.
publish the live improvement dashboard as a private Claude Artifact. The dashboard now uses inline SVG and no external assets.
rewrite prose across plugin files to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape. "harness" stays: standard term for this plugin.

keep/discard no longer requires git. The experiment loop now snapshots target files into .autoresearch/snapshot/ instead of committing and checking out, so /autoresearch:improve runs against any directory, not just a git repo.
stops polluting real repos with per-iteration commits. Nothing read that history. The dashboard sources reasoning and diff_summary from experiments.json.
iterations no longer record a commit SHA in experiments.json (iteration number already identifies them).
tests/test_snapshot.sh: 12 assertions, including that a discard reverts to the last kept state rather than the baseline.
collapse experiment-loop Rules into steps
source improve.md libs via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}
merge harness plugin into autoresearch (single plugin)
glass + depth dashboard redesign
redesign eval dashboard (Linear/Vercel-grade visuals + motion)
move harness commands and probes to standalone harness plugin
convert harness-check and harness-improvement to deprecation shims
infer metric direction, fix improvement %
initial release of autoresearch plugin

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.taglineHtml: Multi-agent PR review with a per-repo policy layer
plugins.summaryHtml: Runs five reviewers in parallel on a PR: correctness, tests, security, ops, and simplicity (ponytail and /simplify rules). If the repo has a local review policy, a sixth reviewer cites the repo's own red-flags, pitfalls, and hotspots. Includes refresh-policy, which learns that policy from merged git and PR history. After the report, it builds a local review page that you read step by step: architecture diagrams before and after the PR, then each finding with the real code as evidence. You choose a call for each finding and paste the reply into the chat. Claude posts the GitHub review after your approval.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 多代理 PR 審查，加上各 repo 自己的審查政策
zhTW.summaryHtml: 外掛在 PR 上平行執行五個審查員。五個審查員負責正確性、測試、安全、維運與簡潔度。簡潔度審查採用 ponytail 與 /simplify 規則。如果 repo 有本地審查政策，第六個審查員會引用它。政策記錄該 repo 自己的警訊、陷阱與熱點。refresh-policy 從已合併的 git 與 PR 歷史學習這份政策。報告之後，外掛會建立一個本地審查頁面，讓你一步一步閱讀。頁面先用架構圖呈現 PR 前後的變化，再逐一列出發現，並用真實程式碼當證據。你為每個發現選擇處理方式，再把回覆貼回對話。你核准後，Claude 在 GitHub 發布審查。

plugins.oneLiner: Multi-agent PR review: five common reviewers (correctness, tests, security, ops, simplicity) plus an optional repo-specific policy reviewer that reads a local .review-policy/ dir, then a step-by-step local review page with before/after architecture diagrams that posts your chosen GitHub review.

commands.name: /code-reviewer:review-pr
commands.descriptionHtml: Multi-agent PR review with an interactive review page: five common reviewers plus an optional repo-specific policy layer

skills.name: refresh-policy
skills.descriptionHtml: Refresh a repo's local review policy (.review-policy/) by learning from merged git + PR history, including reviewer↔author threads.

config.name: CODE_REVIEWER_POLICY_DIR
config.descriptionHtml: Repo review-policy dir. A relative value resolves against the main clone root. Unset means the policy layer is off.

changes.html: Breaking: the review page is a local file built with answer-me-with-html. lib/am.mjs (v0.5.11, MIT) is bundled with its license in lib/am.LICENSE. /code-reviewer:review-pr now needs Node.js 20 or newer.
the page reads from top to bottom: an overview, an architecture diagram before the PR and after it, one panel per finding, then the verdict.

the page builder agent draws the before and after diagrams as class or flow diagrams. The after diagram marks the changed parts. Each diagram lists the refs that it is drawn from, and the builder checks each ref against git.
new ref suffix @base reads the merge base, the commit where the PR branch starts.
Breaking: you answer the questions on the page, press Reply, and paste the reply into the chat. The page is no longer published, has no db, and is not deleted.
lib/build-review-page.py writes an am draft from git evidence and renders it. templates/review-page.html is removed.
the page builder test renders the fixture with the real am CLI.
/code-reviewer:review-pr publishes an interactive review page after the report. For each finding, you choose a call, a fix, and an optional note. The page saves your choices in its own db.

you tell Claude that you are done. Claude then reads your choices, drafts the GitHub review, and posts it with gh after your approval. Then Claude deletes the page once, and Claude Code shows you a delete prompt. If the delete is refused, Claude gives you the page URL and the manual steps.
every run is a new review with a new page and empty choices. The command never reuses an older page or its db.

new review-page-builder agent, lib/build-review-page.py, and templates/review-page.html. The evidence on the page comes from git at the PR head: code lines, diff hunks, and git grep output. Nothing is typed by hand.

new lib/check-base-drift.sh test-merges the PR head into the latest base. Conflicts become a finding. The correctness reviewer searches the test merge for new base code that still uses an API that the PR removes.
each finding carries Ref: evidence refs. The orchestrator writes them to findings.json with stable ids, and it also writes pr.json, drift.json, and report.md.
a gh account fallback. If the active account cannot see the repo, each gh call gets GH_TOKEN for an account that can. The plugin never runs gh auth switch.
tests for the base drift check and the page builder.

Breaking: five owned reviewer agents (correctness, test, security, ops, simplicity) replace the pr-review-toolkit agents and the orchestrator's inline perspectives. The pr-review-toolkit dependency is removed.

Breaking: the repo policy is found only through CODE_REVIEWER_POLICY_DIR. The env vars CODE_REVIEWER_PRINCIPLE_DIR, CODE_REVIEWER_CONFIG_FILE, and CODE_REVIEWER_CACHE_FILE are removed. The plugin no longer reads the files in ~/.claude/code-reviewer/.
Breaking: the skill refresh-principles is renamed to refresh-policy. It keeps only repo-specific concepts.
the orchestrator passes the diff by file path, and reviewers read code at the PR head SHA.
policy severity is set by rule. The report adds Scrutiny, agent counts, and policy coverage lines.
"principle" is renamed to "policy" in libs, agents, skill, and tests.
remove the one-time migrate-to-okf.py script and its test.
rewrite prose across plugin files to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape.
QA fixture representativeness check. Flags synthetic test inputs asserting on diversity-sensitive behavior.
QA verdict → blast radius gate. Flags structural decisions lacking production-shaped test evidence.
mine-git-signals revert chain detection (misdiagnosis signal)
refresh-principles misdiagnosis sequence mining (Pitfall capture)
migrate to OKF v0.2 concept format
reader walks OKF concept bundle, skips deprecated, flags stale
principle-reviewer cites OKF concept paths + trust/stale weighting
deterministic old→OKF bundle migration transform
refresh-principles writes OKF concepts, stamps verified on approval
seed OKF skeleton on bootstrap. Emit concept path in reader header.
compute caused_change from comment outdated-ness
exclude generated/vendored files from churn hotspots
quote YAML-hostile concept titles, capture wrapped What/Why lines
OKF concept conformance check replaces evidence-line check
add learn-state watermark lib + test helper
add git-signal miner (reverts/hotfixes/churn)
add PR-signal miner with comment→change correlation
add diff-coverage guard (coverage + finding validation)
add refresh-principles producer skill + format reference
wire deterministic coverage guards into orchestrator
handle omitted counts in learn-state write
configurable principle-directory roots
initial release. Principle-aware PR review plugin.

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.taglineHtml: Sound like a person, in zh-TW or English
plugins.summaryHtml: Two skills. distill captures your voice from writing samples into a reusable tone preset; rewrite strips AI-tells from existing text (PR comments, posts, emails) and matches a tone, preserving meaning and never inventing facts. Separate Traditional-Chinese and English rulesets, auto-detected, plus a flag-only audit mode.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 讓文字像真人寫的，支援 zh-TW 與英文
zhTW.summaryHtml: 外掛包含兩個 skill。distill 從寫作範例擷取你的語氣。distill 把語氣存成可重複使用的預設。rewrite 移除既有文字中的 AI 痕跡。適用的文字包括 PR 留言、貼文與電子郵件。rewrite 會配合指定語氣，保留原意，並且絕不捏造事實。繁體中文與英文各有一套規則，外掛會自動偵測語言。另有一個只標記、不修改的稽核模式。

plugins.oneLiner: Distill your writing voice into reusable tone presets and rewrite existing text to sound human (not AI) in zh-TW or English — meaning always preserved.

skills.name: distill
skills.descriptionHtml: Use to capture a writing voice into a reusable tone preset from samples or referenced materials.

skills.name: rewrite
skills.descriptionHtml: Use to humanize / de-AI existing text (PR comments, posts, emails, docs) in Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) or English, preserving meaning.

config.name: HUMANIZE_TONE_DIR
config.descriptionHtml: Folder of your own tone preset .md files. Overrides the built-in presets by name, and is where distill writes new presets.

changes.html: rewrite prose in both skills to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape. Also align the "Do / Do Not" field label between distill's steps and its template.
initial release, a voice distillation and human rewrite plugin
add rewrite and distill skills
add built-in tone presets
add English and zh-TW AI-tells references
add safety-rails reference
add conformance fixtures and check
resolve no-preset fallback and de-dash user-facing prose

plugins.name: adhd-review
plugins.summaryHtml: One ruleset, three layers. Layer 1 shapes every reply — lead with the action, number multi-step work with time estimates, cut preamble/recap/closers, state errors matter-of-factly. Layer 2 governs the final turn of substantial multi-step work with Review-Ready buckets — ✅ Done / ⚠️ Broken / 🙋 What I need from you / 🤖 What I'll do, blockers before FYI, each ask naming why it's yours and asked through the AskUserQuestion picker; a Stop hook asks Claude once to re-ask a plain-text question as a picker. A Visual Layer draws non-linear flow-shaped concepts — branches, loops, state changes, hierarchies — as fenced ASCII diagrams instead of prose, while linear steps stay numbered lists. Applies to the human-facing thread only: a default-on SessionStart hook injects the rules into the main session, so subagent returns stay full-detail. On by default — installing the plugin shapes the main thread out of the box; set CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW=0 to silence a session. Toggle per session with /adhd-review-mode.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 回覆先講行動，阻礙排在參考資訊之前
zhTW.summaryHtml: 一套規則，分成三層。第 1 層調整每一則回覆。回覆先寫行動，多步驟工作加上編號與時間估計。回覆刪除開場白、重述與結尾，錯誤只陳述事實。第 2 層管理大型多步驟工作的最後一則回覆。這則回覆使用 Review-Ready 分類：✅ Done / ⚠️ Broken / 🙋 What I need from you / 🤖 What I'll do。阻礙排在參考資訊之前，每個請求都說明為何由你決定，並用 AskUserQuestion 選單提問。如果一輪回覆以純文字問題結尾，Stop hook 會請 Claude 改用選單重問一次。視覺層把非線性的流程概念畫成 ASCII 圖，取代文字說明。圖放在程式碼區塊中。這類概念包括分支、迴圈、狀態變化與階層。線性步驟仍然用編號清單。規則只套用在面向使用者的主對話。預設開啟的 SessionStart hook 會把規則注入主工作階段。因此，子代理的回傳仍然保留完整細節。外掛預設開啟，安裝後主對話立即套用規則。如果要關閉某個工作階段，請設定 CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW=0。用 /adhd-review-mode 可以切換單一工作階段。

plugins.oneLiner: ADHD-friendly per-reply shaping merged with Review-Ready blocker/FYI handoff summaries. Shapes the human-facing thread only — subagent returns stay full-detail.

skills.name: adhd-review-mode
skills.descriptionHtml: Use to toggle the adhd-review reply style for the current session.

config.name: CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW
config.descriptionHtml: Per-session kill switch for both hooks (rule injection and the picker check). On by default. Set to 0 to disable both for that session; unset (or 1) re-enables. The style targets the main thread only; subagents never inherit it.

changes.html: add a Stop hook, scripts/require-ask-picker.py. When a turn ends with a plain-text question and did not call AskUserQuestion, the hook blocks the turn once and asks Claude to re-ask with the picker. It skips a second stop in a row (stop_hook_active), it obeys CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW=0, and it fails open on errors.
Layer 2 "What I need FROM you" now says to ask each decision with the AskUserQuestion picker, one picker per decision when there are more than 3.

ship the reply rules through the SessionStart hook only. The plugin no longer ships an output style, so you never set outputStyle for it. The rules moved from output-styles/adhd-review.md to scripts/session-rules.md. If your settings set outputStyle to adhd-review:ADHD Review, delete that line.
remove the outputStyle check and the frontmatter strip from scripts/session-start.sh. With one delivery path, the rules cannot load twice.

skip the SessionStart injection when outputStyle already selects ADHD Review. Claude Code loads that body natively, so the hook added a second copy (about 1,374 tokens) at every start, resume, clear, and compact.
set keep-coding-instructions: true on the output style. Without it, Claude Code removes its built-in software engineering instructions while the style is active.
rewrite skills/adhd-review-mode/SKILL.md to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape.
rewrite the remaining prose (Scope guard, Layer 1, Visual Layer, Layer 2) to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape.
add a hard rule to the Visual Layer. Diagrams in a reply are always ASCII. Never use mermaid, since a plain chat reply cannot render it as a picture.

remove the Language Layer (the embedded ASD-STE100 Simple English rules). This plugin now covers reply shaping only. Install the simple-english plugin for language rules. That plugin already covers this job.
strengthen diff instruction with anti-pattern catalog, positive example, and defense-in-depth reinforcement
code-diff format picker rule now demands verbatim code lines, not intent summaries
add Language Layer that enforces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English as mandatory on every reply (all 53 rules + 8 general recommendations)
expand Visual Layer with technique vocabulary (pseudocode, call trees, component/file trees, mermaid, diffs, HTML artifacts)
add format picker for content-type to view mapping (sequence diagrams, diff view, flow diagrams, done/action view)
add Visual Layer with fenced ASCII diagrams for flow-shaped concepts
default-on with per-session opt-out
initial release of ADHD-friendly per-reply shaping + Review-Ready handoff summaries

plugins.name: receipts
plugins.summaryHtml: A Stop hook that enforces provable claims. When the finished turn asserts a FACT: or a completion ('verified', 'tests pass', 'fixed', 'done'), a free deterministic prefilter checks it against that turn's real tool calls; only genuinely ambiguous claims escalate to a fresh-context Haiku judge. Unbacked claims are flagged with a ⚠ note (default warn mode) — or hard-gate the turn in block mode, where Claude must prove each with a real tool call or downgrade it to ASSUME: — bounded to one challenge per claim per session (ledger + stop_hook_active backstop). Enforces the fact-assume discipline (FACT = provable if challenged) that RLHF's confident 'done' quietly erodes. On by default and fail-open; set CLAUDE_RECEIPTS=0 to disable. /receipts prints the session's audit ledger and sets the mode.

zhTW.summaryHtml: receipts 是一個 Stop hook，要求每個主張都能證明。回合結束時，如果回覆宣稱 FACT: 或完成，receipts 會檢查它。完成的說法包括 'verified'、'tests pass'、'fixed'、'done'。免費的確定性預篩先用該回合真實的工具呼叫比對主張。只有真正模糊的主張，才交給全新脈絡的 Haiku 評審。沒有證據的主張會加上 ⚠ 註記，這是預設的 warn 模式。block 模式會擋下該回合。Claude 必須用真實的工具呼叫證明每個主張，或把它降級為 ASSUME:。每個主張在每個工作階段只挑戰一次，由 ledger 與 stop_hook_active 做後援。外掛落實 fact-assume 原則：FACT 必須在受到質疑時可以證明。RLHF 帶來的自信「done」會悄悄侵蝕這個原則。外掛預設開啟，出錯時放行（fail-open）。設定 CLAUDE_RECEIPTS=0 可以停用。/receipts 會列出工作階段的稽核 ledger，並設定模式。

plugins.oneLiner: Stop-hook claim auditor — every **FACT:** / 'verified' / 'tests pass' claim must trace to a real tool call in the transcript, or Claude is flagged (or blocked, in block mode) until it proves the claim or downgrades it to **ASSUME:**. Hybrid deterministic prefilter + fresh-context Haiku judge. On by default (mode: warn), fail-open.

commands.name: /receipts:receipts
commands.descriptionHtml: Show this session's receipts audit ledger, or set the audit mode: /receipts [block|warn|report|default].

config.name: CLAUDE_RECEIPTS
config.descriptionHtml: Master switch. On by default — installing the plugin activates the auditor. Set to 0 to disable it for a session (1 also works, redundantly).

config.name: CLAUDE_RECEIPTS_MODE
config.descriptionHtml: warn (default) = allow the turn but inject a ⚠ note listing unbacked claims; block = hard-gate them until proven/downgraded; report = silent audit log only. Change per session with /receipts block|warn|report (persists until /receipts default); the /receipts override file takes precedence over this env var.

config.name: CLAUDE_RECEIPTS_MODEL
config.descriptionHtml: Model for the fresh-context judge that resolves the ambiguous claims the deterministic prefilter can't settle.

changes.html: the labeled fixture now stores each claim's real turn (turn_text, final_text) for the 53 rows whose transcript still exists, so the eval scores extraction the way production sees it instead of feeding it the lone claim as if it were the whole turn.
recall goes 0.200 to 0.600 on the same labels. Two mid-turn narrations stop being scored as claims, because a completion verb only counts in the final message, and two real bluffs start being caught.
tool evidence is stored only on the adjudicated rows, which are the ones labeled for what classify decides. Storing it everywhere put a single 249 KB turn in the fixture.
attach_turn_context.py rebuilds the fixture from the transcripts, so labels added later can pick up their turn context while it is still on disk.

a lone slug or file name no longer backs a claim. The verbatim span must contain at least two words, because an ls line carrying a handover's name was backing the table cell that claimed it had been archived.

contradict a success claim only when exactly one command in the turn looks like a test, build or lint run. With several runs there is no cheap way to attribute the failure, and picking the failing one called true claims bluffs: "Test 1 passes" was contradicted by an unrelated command reporting "1 error".

drop "works" from the completion verbs. It reads as an observation in "the fix works" and as an opinion in "it works best as a secondary cross-check", and the second sense had a real analysis paragraph logged as a bluff.
on the labeled set: precision 1.000 (was 0.250), recall 0.200, escalation_rate 0.419, dropped_at_extraction 69. All three fixes trade flagging for deferral, so precision rises while recall holds.

a claim is backed only when tool output repeats a run of it word for word (24 characters or more). Shared vocabulary proved nothing: replaying 71 real ledger turns showed 47 of 52 backed verdicts resting on one shared word against a median claim of 8, so "W2a is done: 55 tests pass" came back backed by an agent's boilerplate line containing "files".
scope the failure signal to the tool that ran the work. An unrelated gh call exiting 1 in the same turn used to mark a true "All 15 tests pass" as a bluff.
replay_ledger.py rejoins a ledger claim to the transcript turn that produced it, so an old .log row can be re-judged against its real evidence.
10 ledger claims adjudicated against their full turn evidence by a fresh-context subagent, each row carrying that evidence so the eval exercises the evidence rules.
on the labeled set: precision 0.250, recall 0.200, escalation_rate 0.351, dropped_at_extraction 69. The first two were 0.000 before, because the label set held no positive class.
baseline (provisional labels, structural non-claims only) on the labeled set: precision 0.000, recall 0.000, escalation_rate 0.406, dropped_at_extraction 64
audit the final assistant message, not every line of the turn. Table rows, headings, and **ASSUME:** lines are no longer claims.
a claim is backed only when a tool's OUTPUT shows it. A file name in a tool input no longer counts.
every verdict carries evidence, and the ledger is JSONL.
unproven records a claim the judge could not reach, which used to be logged as backed.

run the Haiku judge from a neutral folder with --safe-mode and no tools. A judge call no longer loads plugins, hooks, skills, agents, MCP servers, or CLAUDE.md. A test call used about 3,600 input tokens, down from about 44,000 in 0.2.1.
rewrite prose in commands/receipts.md and this changelog to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape.
default-on with per-session opt-out
initial release, a claim-verification Stop hook
tuned prefilter (autoresearch iterations: 75→100 score)

plugins.name: obsidian-kit
plugins.taglineHtml: One plugin for the vault: draw, format, tag
plugins.summaryHtml: create-excali and update-excali build Excalidraw drawings through ExcalidrawAutomate, lint the geometry, and review the real PNG render. format-note writes and checks notes by their note-type (map, concept, takeaway, literature, fleeting) and keeps the ASCII-diagram and callout rules of the old visualize skill. migrate-notes sets note-type across a vault and renames map notes, as one approved plan. audit-tags finds false, duplicate, typo, and off-taxonomy tags and applies one approved rename plan with backups. session-wrap-up, session-pick-up, and session-recommend turn a working session into reflection take-aways and, after one approval, Zettelkasten cards in the vault. A dedicated skill writes and checks controlled Traditional Chinese inside the vault. A SessionStart hook primes Claude to treat the obsidian CLI as the source of truth. Vault opinions live in the vault file .obsidian-kit.json. No cross-plugin deps.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 一個外掛管好筆記庫：繪圖、格式、標籤
zhTW.summaryHtml: create-excali 與 update-excali 用 ExcalidrawAutomate 建立 Excalidraw 圖。這兩個 skill 會檢查幾何，並審查實際輸出的 PNG。format-note 依筆記類型撰寫與檢查筆記。筆記類型包括 map、concept、takeaway、literature 與 fleeting。format-note 保留舊 visualize skill 的 ASCII 圖與 callout 規則。migrate-notes 為整個筆記庫設定筆記類型，並重新命名 map 筆記。這些變更合成一份計畫，核准後才執行。audit-tags 找出錯誤、重複、錯字與不在分類表中的標籤。它套用一份核准過的重新命名計畫，並先建立備份。session-wrap-up、session-pick-up 與 session-recommend 把工作階段整理成反思重點。核准一次後，它們會在筆記庫中建立 Zettelkasten 卡片。一個專用 skill 在筆記庫中撰寫與檢查受控繁體中文。SessionStart hook 引導 Claude 以 obsidian CLI 為準。筆記庫的偏好設定存放在筆記庫檔案 .obsidian-kit.json 中。外掛不依賴其他外掛。

changes.html: the handover commands moved to the wStack plugin. obsidian-kit no longer ships them, their hook, or their scripts. Install wStack 0.2.0 or later and use the new commands.
vault.py no longer holds the handover helpers. The handoverArchiveRoot key in .obsidian-kit.json has no effect. OBSIDIAN_KIT_OFFER_HANDOVER has no effect.

handover-init-service adds handover to .gitignore, not handover/. A pattern that ends in / matches only a real directory, so git did not ignore the ./handover symlink. The present check now accepts only handover or /handover. If a .gitignore holds only handover/, the command keeps that line and appends handover.

kit.arrow, kit.flow, and fork and merge arrows are now Excalidraw elbow arrows: an orthogonal path with one jog, bound in orbit mode, muted, 1.5 px, roughness 1. straight: true keeps a straight arrow. kit.path stays straight. kit.pointer stays curved. Arrow labels sit beside the longest run.
kit.table builds a left/right comparison table: muted rules under the header and each row, no vertical lines, optional group titles. excali-kit.md and principle 5 document it.
the kit.highlight band uses roughness 1, not 2.

Excalidraw drawings use the Cascadia font (fontFamily 3) for all text. style_kit.js sets Cascadia for new text. lint.py warns non-Cascadia font on any other font, so update-excali converts old drawings too.

handover-wrap-up passes the vault-relative file path to obsidian move to=. The CLI reads any to= value with a dot as a file path. An absolute vault path such as /Users/first.last/... contains a dot, so the CLI read the archive folder as a file name. plan_archive now returns the vault-relative path as move_to.

stop linting Markdown files. The PostToolUse .md lint is removed, with SIMPLE_MANDARIN_LINT_EXCLUDE. The Stop check on Mandarin chat replies stays, renamed from mandarin-lint.py to mandarin-reply-check.py. The Mandarin rules still load at session start inside a vault.
absorb session-learner as session-wrap-up, session-pick-up, and session-recommend. session-pick-up now writes cards into the vault after one approval.
absorb hh as handover-new, handover-wrap-up, handover-init-org, and handover-init-service.
absorb simple-mandarin. Its rules and lint now run only inside a vault.
handover discovery uses the Obsidian tag index and the current taxonomy. The old grep for the retired handover tag matched nothing.
archiving moves the file and never renames it, so wikilinks keep resolving. The living and historical reference classifier is gone.
one vault resolver. HH_LIFEOS_ROOT, HH_ARCHIVE_ROOT, and CLAUDE_SIMPLE_MANDARIN are deleted. OBSIDIAN_KIT_MANDARIN and OBSIDIAN_KIT_OFFER_HANDOVER replace the two behavior toggles.
absorb the three session reflection skills as session-wrap-up, session-pick-up, and session-recommend.
session-pick-up gains a Phase 3 write step. It can save cards into the vault through format-note, gated by one AskUserQuestion approval.
format-note accepts a bold claim inside a quote or callout (> **claim**, > [!danger] **claim**).
format-note no longer asks a map directly in a type folder to be renamed, matching migrate-notes 1.0.1.
Sources: is optional for concept and takeaway notes. Related: stays required.
a literature note can name its source with > Link: <url>, > Source: <name>, or a Sources: line. A literature note beside a 00__map__ note needs none, because the map names the series source.
audit-tags ends a tag at the next #. A false tag glued to another one (PR #1/#3, #1-#10) is wrapped in backticks. 1.0.1 skipped 19 such tags in LifeOS.

one tag must be a prefix covering at least half of the other for audit-tags to suggest a duplicate. The abbreviation rule is gone, because on real tags it only produced false merges (ci→containers, sre→serverless, clickhouse→cli).
migrate-notes keeps the name of a map note that sits directly in a type folder such as Permanent/. It no longer renames the note after that folder.
rename note-visualizer to obsidian-kit. The visualize skill becomes format-note.
add create-excali and update-excali, moved from the LifeOS vault skill excalidraw-refine.
add migrate-notes and audit-tags.
absorb obsidian-markdown and obsidian-bases from kepano/obsidian-skills (MIT).
add a SessionStart primer for the obsidian CLI and defuddle.
the PostToolUse reminder returns additionalContext, so it reaches Claude. It used systemMessage, which only the user sees, so the reminder never steered the model.
the reminder fires only for Markdown files under a Zettelkasten/ folder. Before, it fired on every Markdown edit in every project, including READMEs and CHANGELOGs.

add a PostToolUse hook (hooks/hooks.json + hooks/remind-visualize.py) that reminds Claude to apply the visualize principle on any markdown edit, in any project. Replaces the plugin's earlier "no hooks" design.
add a sequence-diagram style to the visual-patterns reference, for flows with 3+ participants trading ordered messages. Includes its own line and width budget.
rewrite the visualize skill's prose to clear the simple-english linter. No content or meaning changed, only sentence shape.
initial release, a visualize skill with inline and batch modes
visual-patterns reference codifying concept-shape → diagram-type mapping, callout rules, and one-screen budget constraints
model-invoked proactive triggering on Zettelkasten/ note writes

plugins.name: apple-kit
plugins.taglineHtml: Apple Notes and Apple Health for Claude Code
plugins.summaryHtml: apple-notes creates, reads, edits, moves, and deletes Apple Notes through the notes command of macnotesapp. It selects notes by id, reads a note before it changes it, and asks for approval before every change, in a terminal or over a chat bot. apple-health syncs weight and body fat from an iPhone Shortcut export into a Markdown body log, because macOS cannot read Apple Health. The script uses the Python standard library only, adds rows, fills empty cells, and never changes a value. Vault paths live in the vault file .apple-kit.json. No cross-plugin deps.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 在 Claude Code 使用 Apple 備忘錄與 Apple 健康
zhTW.summaryHtml: apple-notes 透過 macnotesapp 的 notes 指令，建立、讀取、編輯、移動與刪除 Apple 備忘錄。它用 id 選擇備忘錄，修改前先讀取內容。每次修改前，它都會請你核准，在終端機或聊天機器人都一樣。macOS 無法讀取 Apple 健康，所以 apple-health 從 iPhone 捷徑的匯出檔同步體重與體脂，寫進 Markdown 身體紀錄。腳本只用 Python 標準函式庫。它只新增資料列、填入空白格子，絕不修改已有的數值。vault 路徑放在 vault 的 .apple-kit.json 檔。不依賴其他外掛。

skills.name: apple-health
skills.descriptionHtml: Sync Apple Health weight, body fat, and sleep into the vault's body log and sleep log, or set up the iPhone export that feeds them.

skills.name: apple-notes
skills.descriptionHtml: Create, read, edit, move, or delete notes in the Apple Notes app on this Mac.

changes.html: sleep_sync.py turns the Health Export sleep stages into a sleep log, one row per night: bed, wake, asleep, deep, REM, awake, and the UTC offset. Asleep time is the union of stage intervals, so two recording apps do not double count. Naps are left out. The export rewrites the rows of its nights, and a night that the export window can cut only fills a missing row or grows a shorter one. A row with a date that does not parse stays as text.
shortcut.md adds the sleep export, the Morning Gate shortcut with a 3-hour lock, the app-opened automation, and the 90-day backfill.
apple-notes works inside Claude Code's Bash sandbox. Note text is one single-quoted argument, not a heredoc or $(…), and each notes command runs alone, so a host can exclude notes * from the sandbox.

notes_guard.py is now a PreToolUse hook. It blocks a notes edit without --id, with --force, or on a note with lists, tables, images, styling, or tags. Hooks run outside the sandbox, so the check reads the note by id with osascript.

apple-notes skill. It wraps the notes command of macnotesapp, pinned to GitHub commit d2b155a for --id selection and the attachment-safe edit. Every create, edit, move, and delete is a guarded write: find by id, read, check losses with notes_guard.py, show the change, get a yes, write, re-read. Note text goes through a quoted heredoc.

apple-health skill and health_sync.py. The script syncs weight and body fat from the iPhone Health Export Shortcut into a Markdown body log. It adds rows, fills empty cells, never changes a value, and prints nothing on success.

plugins.name: wstack
plugins.taglineHtml: A task workflow: confirm the spec, execute, verify with evidence, deliver
plugins.summaryHtml: wStack runs each task as one pipeline in its own herdr session. It keeps task notes in your Obsidian vault and posts evidence on the pull request. Handover commands pass work between sessions. Service contracts record how each service works, and a drift check finds contracts that no longer match the code.

zhTW.taglineHtml: 任務工作流程：確認規格、執行、以證據驗證、交付
zhTW.summaryHtml: wStack 讓每個任務在自己的 herdr session 裡跑成一條流程。任務筆記存放在你的 Obsidian vault，證據則貼在 pull request 上。交接指令讓工作可以在不同 session 之間傳遞。服務合約記錄每個服務的運作方式，漂移檢查會找出與程式碼不再相符的合約。

changes.html: The retro reads every finished task once, whatever its start date. It marks each task it read with retro_read in spec.md, so a long task is no longer missed.

After the user agrees in the retro, read tasks move to Tasks/_archive/<week>/<task_id>/. The move uses obsidian move, so Obsidian rewrites the links to the moved notes. A failed move puts the files back, and the retro tries again next week.

Each project with a contract keeps a facts file, <app_name>.facts.md, next to its contract. The retro proposes fact candidates from the exit notes and from repeated corrections. The user accepts or rejects each one, and every later task session of the project reads the accepted facts at Confirmation.
/wstack:board shows the size of each task's changes, for example 2 files +4 -1, and the live monitor shows it too.
/wstack:board shows a stalled group: a task session in the executing or verifying stage while herdr reports it idle or done.

In Verify, a test run that reports skipped cases fails its step. A skip that the spec names with a reason is allowed. Verify also lists each place that still names a renamed or moved path, and the reviewer judges each one.
spec.html and review.html live in ~/.wstack/pages/<task_id>/, outside the vault. build-review-page.sh takes a required --page <path>.
A code task started outside herdr puts its worktree under the herdr worktree root, at <root>/<repo>/<branch-slug>, not at ~/.wstack/tasks/<task_id>.
The spec template has a new section, ## Moves and renames.
The README, the spec, and the design describe the archive, the facts file, the task pages, the board changes, and the guards.

/wstack:board lists every open task session (RD) in groups: needs you, stopped, working, paused, finished, and other. It also writes a Notion-style snapshot page, Board/board.html. It offers to close the workspaces of finished tasks, and it skips a worktree that has changes.

/wstack:board --watch opens a live monitor in a herdr pane. Every 3 seconds it shows the stage of each RD, its last tool call, and the subagents that run now with their last tool call. A Bash call shows only its description, never its command text.
Each task records the id of every Claude session that worked on it, in session_ids in spec.md. A restart resumes the last session by its id.
Deliver counts tokens by session id. The new subagent_tokens field holds the tokens of the subagents, and tokens_used keeps its old meaning.
At Deliver, and at a cancel after the retry limit, the RD writes retro-note.md. The note lists slow steps, steps to turn into scripts, gaps in the spec, tool and guard friction, and surprises.

/wstack:run-retro reads the exit notes and the transcript stats of each task: tool calls, errors, repeated commands, and compactions. A repeated command keeps only its command name and the subcommand of a tool such as git. No quoted text or secret reaches the retro files. If the evidence raises a question about one task, the retro asks a read-only fork of that RD's session. It records the answer under ## RD answers.
An RD that opens a herdr pane opens it in its own workspace and closes it before Deliver.
render-page.sh takes an optional --theme-file <path>.
The README, the spec, and CLAUDE.md describe the board, the monitor, the exit note, and the retro reopen.

The contract scripts reject a block-style YAML list for ignore or pending. Before, such a list read as empty, and the check reported fresh. Now contract-check.sh and contract-edit.sh exit 2 and name the key. A blank line or a comment line before the first item does not hide the list.
contract-check.sh exits 2 on a missing or empty argument. Before, it exited 1, which means stale.

The guard no longer asks for a command that only reads a file that names a guarded command, such as cat scripts/evidence-delete.sh. Every part of the command must be a read-only tool. The tools are cat, head, tail, grep, wc, ls, file, stat, diff, and nl. The git commands are diff, show, log, blame, and status. The tool must be called by name and not by path. A git option before the subcommand other than -C, --no-pager, -P, or --no-optional-locks gets the normal check. So does a command that runs other commands, for example with bash, eval, xargs, or -exec. A backtick or a $ expansion other than a plain $name also gets the normal check. A redirect with > also gets the normal check.
The guard also asks before yarn npm publish.
The Deliver contract undo also removes the empty decisions/ and _archive/ folders.
The contract tag uses the same kebab rule as create-handover, so the org BreakinCode gives project/breakin-code/<service>.
The text in start-task/references/confirmation.md says where the gate changes the contract (step G4 and step 9). The contract-edit.sh comment no longer claims it is the only writer.

/wstack:pause-work stops work in the middle, in any session. It writes a resume note first. Then it stops the background agents, shells, and processes that this session started. The note records what it stopped and what still runs. Inside a wStack task, it also sets the task status to paused.

/wstack:resume-work finds the newest pause note for the current folder. It compares the git state with the note, shows the note, and goes on from the next step. It never resets or stashes. For a paused task, it prints the command that resumes the task in its own folder.

A new task status, paused, with paused_from in spec.md. /wstack:start-task --task <task_id> resumes a paused task, and the open-task list shows it. Notes for a session outside a task go in ~/.wstack/pauses/.

/wstack:init-service checks the service contract as its last step. If the contract exists, it reports the status. If there is none, it offers to launch a contract task. Outside herdr, it creates the task and prints the command that starts it.

/wstack:run-retro walks contract drift. It resolves pending write-backs, fetches the base branch, and fast-forwards only a clean base branch. It asks which stale sections to update in the same question as the proposals. It writes the contract under the lock and records the undo under ## Contract.
/wstack:run-retro goes on in a week with no task folders, so the drift walk still runs.
Outside herdr, a code task gets a worktree at ~/.wstack/tasks/<task_id>, and you start claude there. A leftover wstack/<slug> branch stops the launch with exit 6.
A failed launch (exit 4 or 6) sets the task to cancelled.
The guard always asks. WSTACK_GUARD_MODE=deny and the WSTACK_APPROVED=1 prefix are gone.
The guard also catches git and gh called by full path, and it judges each command segment. It sees a switch to the default branch behind a prefix such as env, bash -c, or then.
Web checks run playwright-cli in a scratch folder, pick a free port, and close the browser before they delete the folder. No browser and no .playwright-cli/ folder stay behind.

The contract scripts handle CRLF files, accept only a hex verified_commit, keep file modes, and write set-verified in one step. pending-add skips duplicates. apply warns about a new section and takes a repeatable --section. If a write fails, delete-section exits 2.
The contract hook matches compound and full-path git commands, but not an echoed one.
The gate undo deletes the sections it added and restores verified_commit. A closed pull request sets its decision files to withdrawn, and a retried write-back adds no duplicate decisions.
The redactor keeps short counters, such as max_tokens=4096, and redacts every other secret value, including a 6-digit code and non-string JSON values.
The evidence step replaces old evidence lines, videos are never scaled up, and images are checked against pr_media_max_mb.
The README, the spec, and CLAUDE.md describe the new commands, the drift walk, and the paused status.
The guard asks before a push that follows a switch to the default branch. It also asks for git push --all, for a push inside parentheses, and for pnpm publish, yarn publish, and cargo publish.
The redactor uses one name list for headers, URL parameters, and JSON keys. It also redacts every plain-text evidence file before upload, and it handles text with invalid UTF-8.
A repository in local_evidence_only_repos gets a pull request with no attachments, and Deliver leaves text logs out of the body.
A task folder of any earlier day with the same slug now counts as taken, so the new task gets a new slug.
A second retro in the same week writes <week>-2.md and keeps the first retro.
A contract file in the vault for each mapped service, with plan.md and decisions/ beside it.
A drift check, contract-check.sh. It compares verified_commit with origin/<base_branch> and makes no network call.
A SessionStart hook and a PostToolUse hook. If the contract is stale, they tell the agent. Otherwise they print nothing.
A contract gate for code and ops tasks, before the spec is written. It writes contract-brief.md and a gate patch in the task folder.
A write-back in Deliver. The contract changes after the pull request merges. A closed pull request drops its pending item.
A contract work type that sets up or rebuilds a contract. Deliver moves old vault files into _archive/<task_id>/.
Two agents: contract-reader and contract-historian. The reviewer reports a contract-mismatch finding.
A repository with no service mapping gets no contract. A contract task stops and says to run /wstack:init-service.
Every contract write takes the lock folder <contract>.lock. A busy lock stops the task.
retro is now run-retro. The command is /wstack:run-retro.
review-page is now build-review-page.
evidence is now capture-evidence.
deliver is now deliver-task.
/wstack:init-org (was /obsidian-kit:handover-init-org).
/wstack:init-service (was /obsidian-kit:handover-init-service).
/wstack:create-handover (was /obsidian-kit:handover-new).
/wstack:wrap-up-handovers (was /obsidian-kit:handover-wrap-up).
In wStack, the vault path comes from the wStack vault_path setting, not from OBSIDIAN_KIT_VAULT.
In wStack, init-service writes /handover to the local git exclude file. It never edits .gitignore.
In wStack, the resolvers work inside herdr worktrees and read block-list github_orgs.
In wStack, the archive root is fixed at 04Archive.
A launched task session now gets the idea text, because new-task-folder.sh writes it under ## Goal in spec.md.
Runs one pipeline from /wstack:start-task: Confirmation, Execute, Verify, and Deliver, with fix loops back to Execute and to Confirmation.
Launches each task in its own herdr workspace and Claude session, in a task folder in your Obsidian vault.
Checks the base tools with scripts/preflight.sh and prints an install command for each missing tool.
Builds a review page that fits a 375 px screen, with a sticky navbar and an Excalidraw diagram.
Starts a reviewer agent during Verify. It writes findings into review.md.
Records evidence, compresses it, and uploads it to a private Cloudflare R2 bucket. It attaches copies to pull requests.
Delivers to the targets in the spec. A merge and every other step that you cannot undo wait for your approval.
Supports mobile mode, which also publishes pages as Claude artifacts.
Runs /wstack:retro once a week. A retro analyst agent reads the last 7 days of task folders and proposes improvements.
Guards merges, pushes to the default branch, force pushes, remote branch deletes, R2 deletes, and deploys. It asks you first.
